extensions.name: Culture
extensions.author: Tonda
extensions.description: Culture — low-data listening for Myspoti: tiny audio first, unstoppable playback, small downloads for offline, a data meter, Smart Shuffle, Moods, AutoMix and Auto DJ.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Play a small low-data file instead of the full stream when one is found

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Download small files so songs play offline with no data

actions.name: playback.events
actions.why: Count data used and remember played songs for no-repeat shuffle

actions.name: playback.control
actions.why: Smart Shuffle: reorder the queue so no song repeats

actions.name: player.buttons
actions.why: Add a Smart Shuffle button to the player

actions.name: home.sections
actions.why: Show today's data use and a shuffle mix on Home

actions.name: library.read
actions.why: Read Liked Songs to build the shuffle mix

actions.name: spotify.catalog
actions.why: Read playlist and album tracks to shuffle them

actions.name: storage
actions.why: Keep the data meter and recent plays on the phone

actions.name: network
actions.why: Look for a free legal copy of a song on Archive.org

actions.name: notify
actions.why: Short notes like Smart Shuffle on

extensions.changelog: Auto DJ: tap a mood for a DJ set of that mood, DJ the artist playing, or Start Auto DJ for a mix built from the songs you finish most. When a set ends, Auto DJ starts a fresh one by itself (turn it off in settings). DJ Culture is now Auto DJ.
